dialogs.text: After seeing how seriously Fourmon and Meilhat are taking the performance, I couldn't help but get complacent with my training, I feel like my joints have stiffened up...
So how about acting out a scene with me?
Of course, I'm referring to acting on the stage of the Pankration Ring.
Ready for a scene with me?
Let's get on stage.
Heh, too bad there's no entrance music.
I don't have the time right now...
Then I'll go find something else to do to pass the time... and wait for you.
Sure thing.
You certainly are very accommodating.
I don't have the time right now...
You're always booked, like the hottest act in town. It's okay, I'll wait till you're free.
Ready for a scene with me?
Let's get on stage.
Heh, too bad there's no entrance music.
I don't have the time right now...
Then I'll go find something else to do to pass the time... and wait for you.
I guess I'm the supporting actor this time. But it's fine, my joints are feeling more limber again.
It's thanks to you. Thanks for keeping me company.
You stand out too much for me to not invite you.
Spar me! I'll show you how hard me and my fists are!
Ready to spar with me?
Go ahead, make a move.
Don't mind if I do.
I got other things to do...
I'll wait for you here.
I can't wait!
So what are you waiting for?
I got other things to do...
I'll wait for you here.
I lost... But my spirit remains undaunted!
Regardless, you're a worthy opponent.
